2025-12-31 mamimi fanbox update:

[New Plan]

I'm planning on creating a new plan.

It's the R-18G content plan, and it costs 800 yen.

I apologize for creating such an expensive plan. My earnings have decreased, and I felt the need to try something new.

(My earnings have shrunk to about 1/5 of what they were at their peak.)

I hope you understand.

The existing content will remain the main content.

Whenever I have time, I plan to post hardcore content, such as old Parasite and Futanari, that cater to different tastes, to the new plan. This way, I think we can enjoy each other's content without mixing with existing users.

I plan to work even harder on my drawings next year than I did this year.
